title: Champollion retired model aliases (shared/retired-model-aliases.json)
description: Short model names Champollion USED to accept, each with the exact provider slug it used to stand for. Founder ruling 2026-10-05: exact slugs only, no aliasing — every name in `retired` is REFUSED with a message naming its slug; it never resolves. The bundled mini-schema validator does not support additionalProperties-as-schema, so per-entry validation iterates `retired` against $defs.aliasName / $defs.modelId (see cli/test/shared-ssot-schemas.test.js).

_comment.description: Human note: why these names are retired.

retired.description: Retired short name → the exact slug it used to stand for (used ONLY in the refusal message).

aliasName.description: Retired short name: lowercase alphanumerics and hyphens.

modelId.description: Exact provider-qualified model slug: <provider>/<model>, never a floating id (no leading '~', no '-latest').
